Ordinary Council Meeting 22 September 2026

Tuesday, September 22, 2026 - 05:00 PM

Location: Shire Council Chambers

In accordance with the requirements of s5.25(1)(g) of the Local Government Act 1995 and r12(3) of the Local Government (Administration) Regulations 1996, notice is hereby given that the Shire of Narembeen September Ordinary Council Meeting date has been changed to 22 September 2026, starting at 5:00pm at the Shire of Narembeen Council Chambers.

In accordance with S14I(8) Council hereby gives notice that the audio recording for the Ordinary Council Meeting held on 22 September 2026 is not available due to technical issues with the recording technology.

No improvised recording was made, and it is not reasonably practical to make such a recording, as the issue was only identifiable after the conclusion of the Ordinary Council Meeting, and review of the recording.

Special Meeting of Council - 15 July 2026

Wednesday, July 15, 2026 - 08:00 AM

In accordance with the provisions of Section 5.5(2) of the Local Government Act and Regulation 12(4) of the Local Government (Administration) Regulations 1996, you are hereby notified that a Special Meeting of Council has been convened.

A Special Meeting is required as approval of the development application forms part of the funding conditions associated with a CEACA Limited grant. To meet the requirements, it is necessary for Council to consider the application before the next scheduled Ordinary Council Meeting. As a member of CEACA Limited and a financial contributor to the organisation, it is important that the Shire continues to support the timely delivery of projects funded through the program and meets the associated funding requirements.

Council Meetings

Ordinary Meetings

The Shire of Narembeen meets on the 3rd Tuesday of the month with the exception of January. The Ordinary Meeting of Council commences at 5.00pm.

At each meeting there is a public question time, however, it is requested that if any member wishes to present questions to Council on any matter that they notify the Chief Executive Officer of their attendance so adequate time is made available.

Any special meetings of Council will be advertised on the Shire and Community Resource Centre Notice Board situated at 1 Longhurst Street, and 2/19 Churchill Street Narembeen, in addition to the local Narembeen Newspaper ‘The Fencepost’.
